summary: 36Kr Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, the US-equivalent of a foreign private issuer earnings release. Total revenues rose 33.7% year over year to RMB124.6 million (US$18.4 million); online advertising services revenues increased 38.9% to RMB103.5 million. Gross margin expanded to 66.4% from 54.4%, and net income was RMB15.4 million versus a year-earlier net loss of RMB4.8 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; this is a routine operational update with no special-situation elements.
